terra.problem: Calling Nehemiah the governor is a fact from outside the passage, but it has no supporting reference.
Saying Papa held odd jobs invents work history outside his established story.
The claim that a cookie and water would have changed the whole story invents an outcome the text does not give.
The explanation pads the answer with a flat, obvious distinction between a chair and a room.
“Step out for a bit” suggests a short absence, but the passage does not say how long Nehemiah was away.
“No lease, no negotiating” asserts details about the situation that the passage does not give.
The housing joke implies that the fields were where the Levites and singers lived. The text does not say that.
“No relatives are mentioned” is inaccurate: the verse names Hanan as the son of Zaccur, son of Mattaniah. It does not identify the appointees as Nehemiah's relatives.
“A bold way to start a Sabbath” places the rebuke at the start of the Sabbath, which the text does not say.
The explanation applies the language statement to the children generally. The text specifies half of their children.
